ground_truth.description: The fake `_dispatch_tool` unconditionally returns an empty dict `{}`, so it carries no cost/scorer fields. If the code under test reads reviewer_trial (haiku) scorer cost from `_dispatch_tool`'s result, this stub yields zero cost and the test can pass without ever verifying that the scorer cost is actually accumulated into TrialReport totals — a potential false negative for the very feature (task 1030) being tested.

provenance.runs_db_query: SELECT task_id, project_id, outcome, review_cycles, verify_attempts FROM task_results WHERE review_cycles >= 1, cross-referenced with events (escalation_created, merge_finalized) -- see mining.mine_fn_candidates.
